articles.title: BOJ’s Hawkish Hold: Another 2026 Hike Is Still on the Table
articles.claim_summary: The Bank of Japan maintained its policy interest rate in a hawkish hold, projecting core inflation at or above 2% through its entire forecast horizon with upside price risks. Despite an apparent downgrade to near-term inflation caused by temporary government subsidies, the central bank's underlying policy outlook remains unchanged, keeping additional rate hikes through 2026 on the table.

findings.title: BOJ chief says underlying inflation 'quite close' to price goal - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The article reports BOJ chief stating that underlying inflation is 'quite close' to the price goal, supporting the view that the Bank of Japan sees underlying price trends progressing toward its target and keeping policy normalization on track.

articles.title: Malaysia Sector Outlook: Construction - Year of Execution
articles.claim_summary: 2026 is the Malaysian construction sector's "Execution Year": record 2025 contract awards (RM202.5 billion) are expected to translate into peak earnings delivery for major contractors. Budget 2026 development expenditure eases to RM81 billion (from RM86 billion in 2025), but the 13th Malaysia Plan maintains a RM430 billion total allocation through 2030, sustaining infrastructure commitment. Data centres remain the key structural growth driver alongside transport, industrial parks and renewable energy projects; margin risks from steel/cement/labour inflation are seen as manageable given strong order books.

findings.title: Jati Tinggi bags RM30 mil data centre power job in Johor - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: Jati Tinggi secured a RM30 million data centre power job in Johor, directly supporting the claim that data centres are serving as a key structural growth driver for Malaysian contractors.

findings.title: GDB bags RM119m subcontract for flood forecasting infrastructure project in Sarawak - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: GDB secured a RM119 million subcontract for a flood forecasting infrastructure project in Sarawak, confirming ongoing infrastructure contract awards and project execution in line with sustained government infrastructure commitments.

findings.title: Govt drafting law to regulate data centre growth — Economy Ministry - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The Economy Ministry is drafting legislation to regulate data centre growth, which materially complicates the claim that data centres will continue to serve as an unconstrained structural growth driver.
